record.name: Democratic Republic of the Congo
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. The digital economy ministry reported national AI strategy validation in August 2026, with cabinet adoption still to follow. Its steering and implementation-monitoring arrangements do not establish evaluation of advanced models.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. No retained English query. The retrieved material does not sufficiently establish the national AI governance arrangements. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. No qualifying institute was identified. The digital economy ministry's August 2026 account describes governmental presentation/validation of the AI strategy, an interministerial steering mechanism and subsequent submission for cabinet adoption. Monitoring of strategy implementation is not technical model evaluation. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.

check.language_note: The recorded fr query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: MediaCongo's strategy workshop report and the AI Policy Lab governance profile establish policy context. A second substantive independent account of qualifying institute status was not established. Confidence was low under that rule; none_identified is a bounded search finding, not proof of absence.
check.governance_note: Ministry account describes national AI strategy validation, interministerial steering and a pending cabinet-adoption step.

related_bodies.name: Ministry of the Digital Economy
related_bodies.role: It leads the draft national AI strategy and digital plan 2026-2030; it owns the policy.

related_bodies.name: Congolese Academy of Artificial Intelligence (planned)
related_bodies.role: It is a planned training, innovation and applied-research academy announced by the Ministry of Digital Economy; no designation to evaluate advanced models was identified in the announcement.

record.notes: The newly retrieved ministry account describes August 2026 strategy validation with cabinet adoption still pending. Earlier reporting described a July workshop. A ministry announcement about the planned Congolese AI academy concerns training, innovation and applied research, without a qualifying evaluation designation.

next_check.reason: Check whether the strategy is adopted and whether it creates a governance or evaluation body.
